sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL Power Rankings for Week 11: How did the Denver Broncos hold up over the bye?
sources.description: The Denver Broncos didn’t play last weekend, but a good chunk of prognosticators didn’t move them an inch up or or down in their weekly power rankings. It would seem those writers believe that the bye week shouldn’t change how they ranked those bye teams the week prior. The same cannot be said for all, […]
